instruction: Cinematic medium shot inside a boxing ring. On the left, the East Asian woman in a white ribbed sports bra (R2) stands in profile facing right, extending her left arm. On the right, the Caucasian woman in a black and orange sports top (R1) stands facing her, wrapping a black hand wrap around the East Asian woman's (R2) left wrist. The background features red and black ring ropes and hanging punching bags under cool overhead gym lights.

R2 extends her left arm for R1 to wrap
R1 is the helper applying the wrap while R2 is the recipient

boxing ring with red and black ropes and hanging punching bags
